Subject: MAP: HelioHealth POC activation sprint — org setup & peering timeline

Hi Sam,

Following our demo last week, attached is a first-pass mutual action plan that focuses on the POC activation sprint: org setup, API key provisioning, IP allowlist, and VPC peering windows. Key asks from our side to keep the POC on track:

- Confirm an org admin (email) who can accept Redwood org invites and manage service accounts.
- Provide the source IP ranges to populate into our allowlist (we'll mirror in both staging and the evaluation VPC).
- Confirm whether your infra team prefers a shared service account for the POC or individual ephemeral API keys for each tester.
- Target date for VPC peering (we've tentatively suggested Jun 21–22 for a one-day peering window).

Attachments: Helio_MAP_v0.9.pdf (MAP draft), vpc-peering-diagram.png
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2357/HL-2027-042

If you can send the org admin contact and the IP ranges by EOD Thursday (6/10), we can schedule the peering kickoff and cut the Org invite/API key the following week.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Wilkes <sam.wilkes@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP: HelioHealth POC activation sprint — org setup & peering timeline

Hi Sam / Avery,

Quick technical follow-up to make sure the MAP covers the right implementation details:

- VPC peering: we need the HelioHealth VPC CIDR and the desired routing mode (static routes vs. route propagation). Typical peering prep work: create a peering request + allowlist our peering ASN if you use BGP.
- IP allowlist: provide both public egress ranges (CIDRs) and any specific management IPs. We'll create a scoped allowlist tied to the POC tenant.
- API keys: for evaluation we usually offer both options: short-lived API keys (recommended for security, we provide a one-click rotation script) or long-lived keys scoped to the POC tenant. Which is preferred? We can automate creation once we have the org admin.
- Service accounts: if you want S3/GCS access for artifacts, indicate the bucket names and IAM role mapping.

I'll draft a concise technical checklist and attach to the updated MAP (will push a v0.91 after we confirm CIDRs/org admin).

- Priyom (Solutions Eng)

From: Sam Wilkes <sam.wilkes@heliohealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP: HelioHealth POC activation sprint — org setup & peering timeline

Thanks Avery, Priyom — this looks good.

Org admin: linda.carter@heliohealth.com (she's our cloud infra lead and will accept invites).
IP ranges: 198.51.100.0/24 (primary egress), 203.0.113.0/25 (management team). We'll provide any additional NAT/IP info if it changes.
VPC CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16. We prefer static routes for the peering window and will coordinate a BGP-free setup.
Peering window: Jun 21 (preferred) — we can be flexible on Jun 22 if the window slips. Please schedule a 60-minute kickoff the day prior for validation (Jun 20).
API keys: we'd prefer short-lived keys for the evaluation; please include the rotation script.
Procurement: procurement@heliohealth.com (loop them in for the MAP signoff and SOW).

Can you send an updated MAP with the tech checklist and a final schedule by Friday 6/11? Procurement will need the timeline and SOW stub to move forward.

— Sam

5) Procurement: finalize SOW stub (we will circulate a one-page SOW by 6/11 for procurement review).
